about: HB7a mapping: friction key -> trigger, scope, proposed home, source pointers. Written by Main (every key is `by main`, inferred); the owner corrects it by editing this file. Pointers only: label:<file>#<i> (the row's own i), record:<ws>/<id>, memory:<file>, doc:<repo path>#<heading>. No quoted text. Rows labels-B.json#89, #91, #185, #186, #187 are Main's instructions to workers mislabeled as owner messages (H48 label error); they are relabelled `not-owner` in the labels file (2026-11-12), so they are no longer process rows.

fix-brief-states-the-rule.trigger: a review finding names a family and the fix brief cites only the sample site
fix-brief-states-the-rule.correction: the fix brief states the rule that closes the family and asks for a test that proves the rule
fix-brief-states-the-rule.successful_action: one round closes the family: a parity table or a stub that proves the rule
fix-brief-states-the-rule.home_target: a brief-writing checklist doc that claude/main-prompt.md names for fix briefs
fix-brief-states-the-rule.why_home: it applies only when Main writes a fix brief for a finding family; a standing contract line would be paid on every turn
fix-brief-states-the-rule.worked_if: rounds-to-approve in one finding family drops on review-loop lanes after adoption (H12 eval)

parser-brief-grammar-first.trigger: a lane parses worker free text and the brief gives cases, not a grammar
parser-brief-grammar-first.correction: the first brief states the parser as a transition table and the test enumerates short combinations
parser-brief-grammar-first.successful_action: the parser lane approves without a new entry-validation round
parser-brief-grammar-first.home_target: the same brief-writing checklist doc (section: free-text parsers)
parser-brief-grammar-first.why_home: it applies only to parser briefs, a small class; Main retrieves it when the brief touches a parser
parser-brief-grammar-first.worked_if: review rounds per parser lane before and after (H22 check)

detector-fail-closed-first.trigger: a fix decides a security rule by parsing display or command text
detector-fail-closed-first.correction: the first brief states the fail-closed default (uncertain -> strictest) and the reviewer checks the default
detector-fail-closed-first.successful_action: the detector lane converges without a round per newly found text shape
detector-fail-closed-first.home_target: the same brief-writing checklist doc (section: text-based security detectors)
detector-fail-closed-first.why_home: it applies only to security detectors over text; retrieved with the security brief, not loaded on every turn
detector-fail-closed-first.worked_if: rounds in one source-path-redaction-like family on the next detector lane

model-choice.trigger: workers are dispatched on a model or effort the owner did not intend
model-choice.correction: dispatch uses the model family and effort the owner named for that work
model-choice.successful_action: the routed model matches the owner's stated choice without a reminder
model-choice.home_target: the per-model routing layer (model catalog and router profiles, H15 / HB7c)
model-choice.why_home: the choice is per model and provider; a prompt line cannot change what the router picks
model-choice.worked_if: no model-choice process label after the routing change lands

tools-serve-target-projects.trigger: Main evaluates a code-quality tool against tmux-pi itself
tools-serve-target-projects.correction: tmux-pi tools are evaluated on the target project tmux-pi works on (the battle-soccer clone), not on tmux-pi
tools-serve-target-projects.successful_action: tool evals name a target-project fixture from the first brief
tools-serve-target-projects.why_home: it is Main's standing purpose, needed whenever a tool lane is scoped; it is short and always applies
tools-serve-target-projects.worked_if: no purpose-or-scope-drift label of this point after the line lands

safe-search-from-start.trigger: workers search with shell grep and stop on sensitive-read prompts
safe-search-from-start.correction: workers use safe_grep and safe_read from the first call and Main's packet tells them to
safe-search-from-start.successful_action: no worker permission prompt from a recursive shell search
safe-search-from-start.why_home: it holds for every worker on every route, which is what the worker contract is for
safe-search-from-start.worked_if: worker permission prompts from recursive search per lane fall after the contract line (H27 count)

state-saved-for-restart.trigger: a compaction or session restart loses where work stood
state-saved-for-restart.correction: Main keeps task state in durable records and stops at a clean point before a restart
state-saved-for-restart.successful_action: after a restart Main resumes from records without the owner restating state
state-saved-for-restart.home_target: the work store checkpoint and session-start brief hooks (HB3 tp-agent brief)
state-saved-for-restart.why_home: a hook that always saves and re-reads state does not depend on Main remembering a rule at the moment it matters
state-saved-for-restart.worked_if: no recovery-after-compaction-or-restart label after the hooks are on by default

run-only-affected-tests.trigger: a coder runs the whole suite or unrelated tests while others wait
run-only-affected-tests.correction: a coder runs only the tests that check its change and stops other test runs
run-only-affected-tests.successful_action: lane workers run the affected set and name how they chose it
run-only-affected-tests.home_target: tp-agent dispatch --tests affected (the Test Scope packet section)
run-only-affected-tests.why_home: the dispatcher already computes the set; a default removes the choice instead of asking the worker to remember it
run-only-affected-tests.worked_if: no verification-or-evals label of this point after --tests affected became the lane default

orchestrate-in-parallel.trigger: Main works one item at a time while independent queued work waits
orchestrate-in-parallel.correction: Main checks the queue for independent work and dispatches it in parallel lanes
orchestrate-in-parallel.successful_action: independent queued steps run in parallel without the owner asking
orchestrate-in-parallel.home_target: the run-log queue check Main does at each lane close
orchestrate-in-parallel.why_home: it applies at a decision point (a lane closes or waits), not every turn
orchestrate-in-parallel.worked_if: no delegation-or-model label asking for parallel work after the check is in the lane-close procedure

dispatch-via-tmux-pi-workers.trigger: Main does side work itself or through in-process agents instead of tmux-pi workers
dispatch-via-tmux-pi-workers.correction: side tasks go to tmux-pi workers (panes the owner can see), dispatched through tp-agent
dispatch-via-tmux-pi-workers.successful_action: every side task shows in the tmux-pi worker status
dispatch-via-tmux-pi-workers.why_home: it is Main's standing way of working and always applies
dispatch-via-tmux-pi-workers.worked_if: no label of this point after the line lands

research-before-recommending.trigger: Main recommends a change before checking what was tried and what the options are
research-before-recommending.correction: a researcher worker (a lower-cost model) looks at prior attempts and options before Main recommends
research-before-recommending.successful_action: recommendations cite the research and prior attempts
research-before-recommending.why_home: it applies only when Main prepares an owner decision
research-before-recommending.worked_if: no label asking for research first after adoption

wait-for-findings-before-next-step.trigger: Main starts the next chained or costly step before a pending review or research result
wait-for-findings-before-next-step.correction: the next step in a chain starts only after the review or research that could change it has finished
wait-for-findings-before-next-step.successful_action: no step is redone because a review landed after it started
wait-for-findings-before-next-step.home_target: tp-agent lane step ordering (a dependent step refuses to dispatch while its predecessor review is open)
wait-for-findings-before-next-step.why_home: a refusal at dispatch does not depend on Main remembering the order
wait-for-findings-before-next-step.worked_if: no reworked step caused by an earlier review after the default

continue-while-owner-away.trigger: the owner leaves for hours or days and Main stops at the first decision
continue-while-owner-away.correction: Main keeps working through queued steps, decides by its recommendation within the owner's limits, and stops only at owner-only gates
continue-while-owner-away.successful_action: the owner returns to finished, reviewed steps and a short list of owner-only decisions
continue-while-owner-away.home_target: claude/main-prompt.md (with the owner-only list: pushes, permission prompts, overrides)
continue-while-owner-away.why_home: it holds whenever the owner is away and Main must know it without a reminder
continue-while-owner-away.worked_if: no waiting-or-stall label after the line lands

lm-studio-available.trigger: Main treats the local model server as unavailable or as an owner dependency
lm-studio-available.correction: the local model server runs all the time; Main probes it with a small prompt
lm-studio-available.successful_action: no owner dependency listed for the local model server
lm-studio-available.home_target: a probe command Main runs before reporting it down
lm-studio-available.why_home: a probe answers the question; a remembered rule can go stale
lm-studio-available.worked_if: no label of this point after the probe exists

rigor-matches-real-use.trigger: reviews or guardrails chase contrived inputs to the point of hurting usability
rigor-matches-real-use.correction: judge work by the owner's realistic use; contrived inputs become known limits, not rounds
rigor-matches-real-use.successful_action: reviewers tag findings realistic or contrived and only realistic ones block
rigor-matches-real-use.home_target: agent/roles reviewer role and the brief template
rigor-matches-real-use.why_home: it applies to every review on the realistic-use lanes
rigor-matches-real-use.worked_if: rounds spent on contrived findings drop after the reviewer line

workers-cover-whole-scope.trigger: workers find one or two issues and stop
workers-cover-whole-scope.correction: briefs demand the whole scope (an input-space attack table) and workers report coverage
workers-cover-whole-scope.successful_action: review rounds per lane fall because the first round covers the scope
workers-cover-whole-scope.home_target: the brief-writing checklist doc (section: scope coverage)
workers-cover-whole-scope.why_home: it applies when Main writes a brief

tests-earn-their-place.trigger: workers add a test per finding as ritual
tests-earn-their-place.correction: extend or correct an existing test first; a new test must cover an area that needs it
tests-earn-their-place.successful_action: test count grows only where coverage was missing
tests-earn-their-place.why_home: it holds for every worker that writes tests
tests-earn-their-place.worked_if: test count per lane vs findings per lane

slice-work-incrementally.trigger: a step runs long before any result comes back
slice-work-incrementally.correction: cut work into slices under about 20 minutes that feed improvements back early; the whole-scope run comes last
slice-work-incrementally.successful_action: each slice reports before the next starts
slice-work-incrementally.why_home: it applies when Main plans a step
slice-work-incrementally.worked_if: slice durations in the run log

rules-set-up-once.trigger: Main proposes a maintained pipeline for keeping business rules consistent
rules-set-up-once.correction: Main writes a per-project rule map once and references it; no maintained job
rules-set-up-once.successful_action: rule-consistency work names the map, not a new job
rules-set-up-once.why_home: it applies only to rule-heavy projects
rules-set-up-once.worked_if: no new maintained job proposed for it

gate-commands-run-alone.trigger: a gating command is piped inside an && chain
gate-commands-run-alone.correction: run lane close and review alone, never piped
gate-commands-run-alone.successful_action: the step runs correctly the first time
gate-commands-run-alone.home_target: a gate that fails loudly on a closed pipe
gate-commands-run-alone.why_home: Main's own operating lesson; a default or tool removes the need to remember it
gate-commands-run-alone.worked_if: no repeat of the failure in the run log

lane-create-base-main.trigger: a lane is created on the stale default base
lane-create-base-main.successful_action: the step runs correctly the first time
lane-create-base-main.why_home: Main's own operating lesson; a default or tool removes the need to remember it
lane-create-base-main.worked_if: no repeat of the failure in the run log

lane-verify-includes-session-env.trigger: a scoped lane verify skips the whole-repo guard
lane-verify-includes-session-env.successful_action: the step runs correctly the first time
lane-verify-includes-session-env.why_home: Main's own operating lesson; a default or tool removes the need to remember it
lane-verify-includes-session-env.worked_if: no repeat of the failure in the run log

worker-tests-isolate-tmux.trigger: a worker test touches the default tmux server
worker-tests-isolate-tmux.correction: tests run with TMUX_TMPDIR and a private socket
worker-tests-isolate-tmux.successful_action: the step runs correctly the first time
worker-tests-isolate-tmux.why_home: Main's own operating lesson; a default or tool removes the need to remember it
worker-tests-isolate-tmux.worked_if: no repeat of the failure in the run log

shell-is-zsh.trigger: a bash-style loop runs in the zsh tool shell
shell-is-zsh.correction: loops go in bash script files
shell-is-zsh.successful_action: the step runs correctly the first time
shell-is-zsh.why_home: Main's own operating lesson; a default or tool removes the need to remember it
shell-is-zsh.worked_if: no repeat of the failure in the run log
